note: Arms of the pre-registered follow-up retraining (PR-B). Every arm uses the shipped training.json mix (open x2, MASC, silver >= 80, imperative at weight 1; compound, headings, compound2 and headings2 at weight 0) and its settings; only the feature groups, the added sources, the seed and the refit temperature differ. Group names are the values of the trainer option --features; a source of an arm is trained at weight 1 with the option --source NAME:1, which the driver appends after --calibrate --output. The arms run in file order, BASE first, one driver invocation per arm.
